name: Highlight Reel
description: Finds the good bits of a stream recording and cuts them into one reel. Where the recording overlaps a Power Stream session it reads your chat and gifts straight off disk, so the moments it picks are the ones your audience actually reacted to - not a guess at what a video looks like. Then slice, reorder, add transitions and effects on a timeline and export.
